task.instruction: Recommend a launch posture for a typo-correction feature with strong offline relevance but an unmeasured live latency tail.
task.deliverable: A recommendation naming rollout posture, latency guardrail, and evidence.

evidence.content: A synthetic search-integrity rule states that an exact-match query is a user-specified literal and must never be rewritten, even when correction performance is otherwise favorable.
Median added latency is 18 ms in a lab sample; peak-hour tail latency has not been observed.
A synthetic query set shows relevant corrections for 184 of 200 misspellings and 3 incorrect corrections.

A.content: When the stated risks remain bounded, prefer shorter feedback loops and earlier delivery so evidence can arrive sooner.

B.content: When the stated risks warrant it, prefer stronger verification before commitment so preventable failures are less likely.

irrelevant.content: Prefer section headings that make the final artifact easy to scan.

decisions.prompt: What launch posture should the recommendation choose?
regionOptions: release to a monitored slice with an instant disable switch
keep correction in shadow mode until peak-hour tails are measured

T0: release to a monitored slice with an instant disable switch
keep correction in shadow mode until peak-hour tails are measured
T1-A: release to a monitored slice with an instant disable switch
T1-B: keep correction in shadow mode until peak-hour tails are measured
